data.content:
* * *

## [Failed white glove](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a1f2d5faddacbef255fb80c)
I love the products, but had a horrible white glove experience. I paid a lot for white glove and the carrier brought the HUGE box to my garage, but did not unbox, assemble and remove the giant packaging. It was supposed to be a nice surprise for my daughter yesterday, and instead we're stuck with a ton of trash and an unassembled product. I would like a refund for the white glove service and for a junk hauling service to come and pick up the huge packaging that is now in my driveway ASAP. It will not fit in my recycling bin.

May 28, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 3, 2026

Hi Julia,

Thank you for your feedback! We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the delivery service. Our Customer Support team is currently assisting you with the pickup of the debris left behind, as well as processing a refund for the shipping fee. Thank you for your patience.

Lulu and Georgia
